real: Official @modelcontextprotocol/client v2 beta Client and Streamable HTTP transport negotiated the modern protocol against a real loopback HTTP endpoint.
Official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk v1 Server exercised automatic legacy fallback without Tasks capability.
Exact external method names, payloads, Mcp-Name/Mcp-Method headers, capability declaration, tested protocol revision, and frozen Schema validation were asserted on the HTTP wire.
simulated: The loopback Provider business behavior is deterministic: sync_success, async_success, rejected_without_task, malformed task IDs, unknown task status, and unknown task fields.
No external production MCP Provider or production credentials were used.
unverified: Durable remote-task bindings, ordered observations, BullMQ polling, startup reconciliation, and PostgreSQL/Redis recovery are Phase 2.
Availability/timing, external continuation, input/cancellation lifecycle, management UI, all 16 acceptance scenarios, and final release integration are Phases 3-6.

limitations: The exact beta.4/extension-draft combination is contract-tested; compatibility with other beta or protocol revisions is not claimed.
The temporary result/method/header bridge is confined to packages/mcp-adapter and emits the frozen external wire contract.
apps/server deliberately rejects remote_task outcomes with MCP_REMOTE_TASK_PHASE_NOT_CONNECTED until Phase 4 connects durable continuation; ordinary immediate Tool behavior remains operational.
